title: Creating an End to the Workday
summaryZh: 一位混合辦公的上班族發現工作侵入晚間生活，於是建立簡單的下班儀式和溝通界線。

sentences.text: When my company introduced hybrid work, I expected my days at home to feel easier.
sentences.zh: 公司開始混合辦公時，我原以為在家工作的日子會比較輕鬆。

sentences.text: My commute disappeared, and I could make lunch in my own kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我不必通勤，也可以在自己的廚房做午餐。

sentences.text: Within a month, however, it felt as if my desk never really closed.
sentences.zh: 然而不到一個月，我就覺得辦公桌好像從來沒有真正關閉過。

sentences.text: I answered messages during dinner simply because my laptop was still in sight.
sentences.zh: 我會在晚餐時回覆訊息，只因為筆電還在視線之內。
sentences.note: in sight 表示在看得到的範圍內。

sentences.text: The problem was not only the amount of work, but also the lack of a clear ending.
sentences.zh: 問題不只是工作量，也在於一天的工作沒有明確終點。

sentences.text: I decided to create a short routine that would tell my brain the workday was over.
sentences.zh: 我決定建立一套簡短流程，提醒大腦工作日已經結束。

sentences.text: At six thirty, I wrote down the first task for tomorrow and closed every work app.
sentences.zh: 六點半時，我會寫下明天的第一項任務，然後關閉所有工作應用程式。

sentences.text: I put the laptop in a drawer and folded the small desk in the corner of my apartment.
sentences.zh: 我把筆電收進抽屜，再把公寓角落的小桌子折起來。

sentences.text: Then I took a fifteen-minute walk around the block before starting dinner.
sentences.zh: 接著我會在準備晚餐前，繞著街區走十五分鐘。

sentences.text: The walk became a replacement for the commute that used to separate work from home.
sentences.zh: 這段散步取代了過去用來分隔工作與家庭生活的通勤。

sentences.text: I also told my team when I would be offline and how to reach me in a real emergency.
sentences.zh: 我也告訴團隊我的離線時間，以及真正緊急時該如何聯絡我。

sentences.text: I worried that I would seem unresponsive, but urgent evening requests were actually rare.
sentences.zh: 我曾擔心自己看起來回應不夠積極，但晚間的緊急要求其實很少。
sentences.note: unresponsive 在職場中可指沒有及時回應。

sentences.text: Quarter-end deadlines still keep me late sometimes, so the routine is not a perfect rule.
sentences.zh: 季末期限有時仍讓我加班，所以這套流程並不是絕對規則。

sentences.text: The difference is that working late is now a conscious choice instead of my daily default.
sentences.zh: 不同的是，現在晚點工作是有意識的選擇，而不是每天的預設狀態。
sentences.note: a conscious choice 指經過思考後主動做出的選擇。

questions.q: What first showed the writer that work had entered personal time?
Why does the writer walk before dinner?
options: To replace the separation once provided by commuting
To meet coworkers who live nearby

questions.q: What does the writer admit about the routine?
options: It only works in a large home
It sometimes changes during busy periods
